paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter through nuclear spin precession in electric and magnetic fields
notes: Search for oscillating neutron EDM (and axion-wind effect) using ratio of UCN and 199Hg spin-precession frequencies. Fig 2 gives 95% C.L. limits on oscillation amplitude of dn-(mu_n/mu_Hg)dHg in units of 1e-26 e*cm vs frequency, combining long time-base (ILL) and short time-base (PSI) analyses. Mass=4.136e-15*f[Hz]. Data points approximate from Fig 2. The paper's headline plots (Fig 4) recast these as axion-gluon coupling CG/fa and axion-nucleon coupling CN/fa (GeV^-1); coupling type is somewhat ambiguous between AxionEDM (the directly measured oscillating EDM amplitude), the gluon coupling, and AxionNeutron (axion-wind). Assumes axions saturate local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3.
